mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id AS workspaceId, agent_id AS agentId, agent_version_id AS agentVersionId, thread_id AS threadId, turn_id AS turnId, orch_run_id AS orchRunId, item_id AS itemId, seq, tool_name AS toolName, action_class AS actionClass, risk, reversibility, status, gate, args_json AS argsJson, change_set_json AS changeSetJson, fingerprint, estimated, valid_until AS validUntil, records, amount_micros AS amountMicros, approval_id AS approvalId, receipt_json AS receiptJson, undo_deadline AS undoDeadline, undone_by AS undoneBy, undo_reason AS undoReason, autonomy_level AS autonomyLevel, undo_scope_type AS undoScopeType, undo_scope_id AS undoScopeId, compensate_seq AS compensateSeq, undo_attempts AS undoAttempts, create_at AS createAt, update_at AS updateAt FROM trust_action WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, workspace_id AS workspaceId, agent_id AS agentId, agent_version_id AS agentVersionId, thread_id AS threadId, turn_id AS turnId, orch_run_id AS orchRunId, item_id AS itemId, seq, tool_name AS toolName, action_class AS actionClass, risk, reversibility, status, gate, args_json AS argsJson, change_set_json AS changeSetJson, fingerprint, estimated, valid_until AS validUntil, records, amount_micros AS amountMicros, approval_id AS approvalId, receipt_json AS receiptJson, undo_deadline AS undoDeadline, undone_by AS undoneBy, undo_reason AS undoReason, autonomy_level AS autonomyLevel, undo_scope_type AS undoScopeType, undo_scope_id AS undoScopeId, compensate_seq AS compensateSeq, undo_attempts AS undoAttempts, create_at AS createAt, update_at AS updateAt FROM trust_action WHERE approval_id = #{approvalId} ORDER BY create_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE trust_action SET approval_id = #{approvalId}, update_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND approval_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id AS workspaceId, agent_id AS agentId, agent_version_id AS agentVersionId, thread_id AS threadId, turn_id AS turnId, orch_run_id AS orchRunId, item_id AS itemId, seq, tool_name AS toolName, action_class AS actionClass, risk, reversibility, status, gate, args_json AS argsJson, change_set_json AS changeSetJson, fingerprint, estimated, valid_until AS validUntil, records, amount_micros AS amountMicros, approval_id AS approvalId, receipt_json AS receiptJson, undo_deadline AS undoDeadline, undone_by AS undoneBy, undo_reason AS undoReason, autonomy_level AS autonomyLevel, undo_scope_type AS undoScopeType, undo_scope_id AS undoScopeId, compensate_seq AS compensateSeq, undo_attempts AS undoAttempts, create_at AS createAt, update_at AS updateAt FROM trust_action WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trust_action ( id, workspace_id, agent_id, agent_version_id, thread_id, turn_id, orch_run_id, item_id, seq, tool_name, action_class, risk, reversibility, status, gate, args_json, change_set_json, fingerprint, estimated, valid_until, records, amount_micros, approval_id, receipt_json, autonomy_level, undo_scope_type, undo_scope_id, compensate_seq, undo_attempts, create_at, update_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{agentId}, #{agentVersionId}, #{threadId}, #{turnId}, #{orchRunId}, #{itemId}, #{seq}, #{toolName}, #{actionClass}, #{risk}, #{reversibility}, #{status}, #{gate}, #{argsJson}, #{changeSetJson}, #{fingerprint}, #{estimated}, #{validUntil}, COALESCE(#{records}, 0), #{amountMicros}, #{approvalId}, #{receiptJson}, #{autonomyLevel}, #{undoScopeType}, #{undoScopeId}, #{compensateSeq}, COALESCE(#{undoAttempts}, 0), now(), now() )
mapper.update: UPDATE trust_action SET status = #{toStatus}, receipt_json = COALESCE(#{receiptJson}, receipt_json), undo_deadline = COALESCE(#{undoDeadline}, undo_deadline), update_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{fromStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(seq), 0) + 1 FROM trust_action WHERE turn_id = #{turnId}

SELECT id, workspace_id AS workspaceId, agent_id AS agentId, agent_version_id AS agentVersionId, thread_id AS threadId, turn_id AS turnId, orch_run_id AS orchRunId, item_id AS itemId, seq, tool_name AS toolName, action_class AS actionClass, risk, reversibility, status, gate, args_json AS argsJson, change_set_json AS changeSetJson, fingerprint, estimated, valid_until AS validUntil, records, amount_micros AS amountMicros, approval_id AS approvalId, receipt_json AS receiptJson, undo_deadline AS undoDeadline, undone_by AS undoneBy, undo_reason AS undoReason, autonomy_level AS autonomyLevel, undo_scope_type AS undoScopeType, undo_scope_id AS undoScopeId, compensate_seq AS compensateSeq, undo_attempts AS undoAttempts, create_at AS createAt, update_at AS updateAt FROM trust_action WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND status = 'APPLIED' AND undone_by IS NULL AND COALESCE(update_at, create_at) >= #{fromUtc} AND COALESCE(update_at, create_at) < #{toUtc}

SELECT id, workspace_id AS workspaceId, agent_id AS agentId, agent_version_id AS agentVersionId, thread_id AS threadId, turn_id AS turnId, orch_run_id AS orchRunId, item_id AS itemId, seq, tool_name AS toolName, action_class AS actionClass, risk, reversibility, status, gate, args_json AS argsJson, change_set_json AS changeSetJson, fingerprint, estimated, valid_until AS validUntil, records, amount_micros AS amountMicros, approval_id AS approvalId, receipt_json AS receiptJson, undo_deadline AS undoDeadline, undone_by AS undoneBy, undo_reason AS undoReason, autonomy_level AS autonomyLevel, undo_scope_type AS undoScopeType, undo_scope_id AS undoScopeId, compensate_seq AS compensateSeq, undo_attempts AS undoAttempts, create_at AS createAt, update_at AS updateAt FROM trust_action WHERE (#{scopeType} = 'turn' AND turn_id = #{scopeId}) OR (#{scopeType} = 'run' AND orch_run_id = #{scopeId}) OR (#{scopeType} = 'action' AND id = #{scopeId}) ORDER BY seq DESC

SELECT id, workspace_id AS workspaceId, agent_id AS agentId, agent_version_id AS agentVersionId, thread_id AS threadId, turn_id AS turnId, orch_run_id AS orchRunId, item_id AS itemId, seq, tool_name AS toolName, action_class AS actionClass, risk, reversibility, status, gate, args_json AS argsJson, change_set_json AS changeSetJson, fingerprint, estimated, valid_until AS validUntil, records, amount_micros AS amountMicros, approval_id AS approvalId, receipt_json AS receiptJson, undo_deadline AS undoDeadline, undone_by AS undoneBy, undo_reason AS undoReason, autonomy_level AS autonomyLevel, undo_scope_type AS undoScopeType, undo_scope_id AS undoScopeId, compensate_seq AS compensateSeq, undo_attempts AS undoAttempts, create_at AS createAt, update_at AS updateAt FROM trust_action WHERE ( (#{scopeType} = 'turn' AND turn_id = #{scopeId}) OR (#{scopeType} = 'run' AND orch_run_id = #{scopeId}) OR (#{scopeType} = 'action' AND id = #{scopeId}) ) AND status = 'COMPENSATING' ORDER BY seq ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE trust_action SET undo_scope_type = #{scopeType}, undo_scope_id = #{scopeId}, compensate_seq = #{seq}, update_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE trust_action SET undo_attempts = COALESCE(undo_attempts, 0) + 1, update_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
